label: Whatever begins or ceases to live between an earlier and a later time of the…, from immutability
description: Contrapositive of ST I q.10 a.1 under excluded middle: whatever is in potency in no respect has no beginning or end of life (STMT-IMMUTABLE-HAS-NO-LIFE-BOUNDARY, supported by the q.10 a.1 claim), so whatever begins or ceases to live is in potency in some respect. Derives STMT-LIFE-BOUNDARY-REQUIRES-POTENCY, which reaches the root without a derivation. This is a logical rearrangement: the gap the target carried (potency in the subject versus in another) now sits in the reading of 'omnino immutabile'. Both premises stay open.
